on a drawing: a decimal point, a tolerance, an H7, a 6 against an 8. Use this to find WHICH
drawing to open. Then open it:  pdftoppm -r 300 -png -f <page> -l <page> v2/vendor/m2/amphenol-mdt420m02001-m2-m-key.pdf
Every dimension quoted anywhere in this project must come from the drawing, never from here.
